about: SCION 23 track timeline: clips queued on animation tracks with mix durations. Track 0 = body, track 1 = head (layered over the body on neck, head and ears). clip null = empty (mix the track out). Root x comes from the score; feet from the foot planner.

entries.why: watching the person in the doorway
the call (voice from 0.88 s): crouches and backs away
called again and reached for (voice from 3.30 s): turns its back
lies down, back to the door
door open, hand low, soft voice from 7.30 s: the head turns back first
the body follows: gets up and comes round
head track hands back to the body
stands facing the door and watches
in its own time: comes, head low
reaches the sill and lies down across it
"come in" (voice from 26.25 s): looks in, into the room
and stays: chin on the paws
head track hands back to the body
